en.headline: Auditor finds Consumer Council missed complaint handling targets
en.dek: The Audit Commission said the Consumer Council failed to meet reply times and resolution rates for complaints in recent years, and noted low usage of its two service centres.
body: The Audit Commission tabled Report No. 87 of the Director of Audit in the Legislative Council on Wednesday morning, examining the economy, efficiency and effectiveness of several public programmes. One chapter reviewed the Consumer Council’s handling of complaints and enquiries.

The report said the council received nearly 175,000 complaints between the 2021-22 and 2025-26 financial years. As of the end of June this year, about 87,500 had been closed. More than 6,900 of the closed cases took over four months to process, and the longest took nearly 40 months.

The auditor noted that the council failed to meet its target of providing preliminary written replies within five working days for all complaints, and within 10 working days for written enquiries. It also fell short of its 67 per cent complaint resolution rate target in four of the five years.

The two service centres in North Point and Tsim Sha Tsui handled only about three per cent of complaints and six per cent of enquiries last year, the report said. The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau and the Consumer Council told the Audit Commission they agreed with the recommendations to improve performance and monitor centre usage.

zh.headline: 審計署指消委會投訴處理未達標 服務中心使用率低
zh.dek: 審計署表示消委會近年未能達到投訴回覆時限及調停成功率目標，北角及尖沙咀服務中心使用率亦偏低。
body: 審計署署長第八十七號報告書於星期三上午提交立法會省覽，審查多項政府計劃及公共服務的節省程度、效率與效益。其中一章檢視消費者委員會處理投訴及查詢的表現。
報告書指出，消委會於2021至2025年度共收到近17.5萬宗投訴。截至今年6月底，約有8.75萬宗已結案，其中超過6900宗處理時間超過四個月，最長個案接近40個月。
審計署留意到，消委會未能達到所有投訴在五個工作天內發出初步書面回覆，以及書面查詢在十個工作天內回覆的目標。過去五年中有四年的投訴調停成功率亦低於67%的目標。
報告書又稱，北角及尖沙咀兩間服務中心去年只處理約百分之三的投訴及百分之六的查詢。商務及經濟發展局和消委會回覆審計署時表示，同意有關改善表現及監察服務中心使用率的建議。
